# Third-party lists (fetched, unmodified)

Fetched by `tools/fetch_lists.py` only when the maintainer decides to update them; the build never downloads.
Source, date, size and SHA-256 of each file: `lists.json`. Licences and credits: `../THIRD_PARTY.md`.

- `easyprivacy.txt` — EasyPrivacy, The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/), GPL-3.0-or-later or CC BY-SA 3.0.
- `cname_original_trackers.txt` — AdGuard cname-trackers, MIT (`LICENSE-cname-trackers.txt`).
